description: Citehound for Make: scan a domain for AI readiness, compare sites, generate llms.txt, robots.txt and schema, and watch monitoring events.

modules.label: Scan a Domain
modules.description: Scans a domain for AI readiness: the score, the pillars, the crawlers and the failed checks. A free key shows the first three findings.

modules.label: Compare Two Domains
modules.description: Scans two domains and lists where they differ. Needs a Pro, Fix or Beyond key.

modules.label: Get Crawler Access
modules.description: The state of ten AI crawlers in robots.txt.

modules.label: Generate llms.txt
modules.description: Builds an llms.txt from a name, a description and key pages. A free key gets a preview.

modules.label: Generate robots.txt
modules.description: Builds a robots.txt that allows or blocks named AI crawlers. A free key gets a preview.

modules.label: Generate Schema
modules.description: Builds JSON-LD from a homepage. A free key can use the organization type.

modules.label: Watch a Domain
modules.description: Adds a domain to the watchlist. Needs a Pro, Fix or Beyond key.

modules.label: List Watched Domains
modules.description: The watchlist with the last scan and score. Needs a Pro, Fix or Beyond key.

modules.label: Get the Fix List
modules.description: The prioritized fix list with the files to paste. Needs a Fix or Beyond key.

modules.label: Watch Monitoring Events
modules.description: Triggers for each new monitoring event: a score drop or rise, a crawler blocked or unblocked, llms.txt added or removed, a check failing or fixed, a scan that failed. Needs a Pro, Fix or Beyond key.
